author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Hola, guys! It's Pyro :D I decided to go ahead and make a DTM map ^_^

Screenies: http://imgur.com/INi42C6,qAndACG,72heo3f,8dhtZmR,CDipf0D,hUOUsJo,WzfFoMi,YtJRRK6,vFr8PEb,p48BCxd,xsf...

YAML: http://pastebin.com/hSAeLuqu

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/ddk3x5hj4q3a4dl/DaBaderMC%233.rar#3.rar

Feature 1: The front 2 monuments both have 1 obsidian while the back 2 have 2 each.

Feature 2: There is a chest  on each team's base that has Diamond legs and a Diamond chestplate. There is also a bow that has 5 uses with 3 enchantments.

Feature 3: 20 v 20

Feature 4: Has 7 diamond blocks at center.

Feature 5: Has plenty of space to PvP

Constructive feedback is welcome. 

Also, thanks to ScriptingLyfe for the server :D

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map has a very interesting layout. While the block palette isn't really that special I think it works nicely. I would love to see some more height changes on the map especially in the middle because theres enough room for it but I think it will be good.

Gameplay should be ok since theres nothing really making it bad.

Overall nice little map. Good job!
